mechanism: Both agents increase photosensitivity and risk of phototoxic reactions; doxycycline may increase intracranial pressure risk when combined with tretinoin's known association with pseudotumor cerebri.
action: Advise strict sun protection (SPF 30+), avoid excessive UV exposure, monitor for signs of intracranial hypertension (headache, visual changes), and consider alternative antibiotics if photosensitivity concerns are significant.
